body:
Steps 3–4 of the refactor plan (task:fc9bf315f4eddc7a, note 6 for the boundaries, note 12 for the updates). This is part 1 of 4 of the module splits. Waits on task:32ad4bda2e68c02d.

- **CLI facade:** move argument parsing, project scoping, batching, probe helpers and command routing into `cli`. Command names and option validation stay unchanged, and the crate-root `main` stays a one-line entry that hands off to `cli`.
- **Model and diagnostics:** move `Failure`, `Out`, `Sym`, `ModuleRow`, `Index`, `Target`, `FileMap` and `Diag`, plus span, warning and broken-report formatting, into their owning modules.

### Rules for every split task

- Move methods with `extract Type::method --to <module>`, and raise visibility only to `pub(crate)`.
- Tests move with their code into `<module>_tests.rs` files. A module that still has an inline `mod tests` can't take moved code (`E1004`), so move code *out* of it first.
- Keep each public symbol reachable by its current name. Remove a wrapper only after `refs` shows nothing calls it.
- After each move, run `check --warnings`, `rust-unit` and the affected acceptance suite. At the end of the task, also run `rust-acceptance` and `spacing_parity`.
title: Refactor: CLI facade and model split
